templates.else: If none of the above is true...
templates.while_true: Repeats everything below forever, until something breaks out.
templates.for_range: Repeats {count} times, with {var} going from {start} to {end}.
templates.for_range_simple: Repeats {count} times, with {var} going from 0 to {end}.
templates.for_in: Goes through each item in {iter}, calling it {var}.
templates.return: Returns {value} to whoever called this function.
templates.break: Stops the loop immediately and exits.
templates.continue: Skips the rest of this cycle and starts the next.
templates.pass: Does nothing and moves to the next line.
templates.except: Catches error {error} if it happens above.
templates.except_all: Catches any error that occurs in the block above.
templates.finally: Runs this cleanup block no matter what happened.
templates.with_as: Opens resource {resource} and assigns it to {alias}.
templates.class: Defines class {name} as a blueprint for objects.
templates.import: Imports module {module} to use its tools.
templates.assert: Checks that {condition} is true, or stops execution.

summary.empty: Paste or type code on the left to see explanations.
